measurement_source: Actual natural-browser Mermaid 12.3.0 invocation dimensions and raw elkjs 0.12.0 output. Read-only hooks copy serializable data immediately before and after the real elk.layout(elkGraph) call; function-valued intersection callbacks are omitted from the copies, never from the graph passed to ELK. Raw section points are translated only by their recorded ELK container origin, before clipping, terminal straightening, and label separation. Node centers used by the SVG writer are captured after the upstream node/frame alignment pass. Native measurements are unchanged; no fonts, dimensions, graph options, placements, or routes are injected. historical_collection is archival metadata only and is not an active oracle.

capture.upstream_svg_match: 43 captured SVGs are byte-identical to the current baselines. Three neo-look fixtures retain class whitespace and label-offset-y metadata differences already reproduced by the uninstrumented selected renderer; all SVG text, geometry, routes, markers, transforms, and other attributes are identical. No baseline or comparator is changed.

historical_collection.measurement_source: Actual instrumented Mermaid ELK invocation input and raw provider output; global points translated only by the recorded ELK container origin, before clipping and terminal straightening. The browser field records the original collection; the four fixtures documented in ADR 0024 were recaptured with HeadlessChrome/151.0.7922.77 on 2026-10-25, while other entries retain their original measurements.

capture.runtime_description: esbuild browser IIFE of installed mermaid; capture-only instrumentation around elk.layout and endpoint sanitization; no algorithm changes
capture.measurement_source: Actual natural-browser Mermaid invocation dimensions and raw elkjs output, copied at elk.layout before endpoint clipping, terminal straightening, or label separation. Native getBBox results are returned unchanged; no fonts or dimensions are injected. Per-entry browser identity supersedes the matrix historical collection browser.
capture.upstream_match: All three final edge d strings and decoded data-points, both edge-label centers and global background rectangles match upstream exactly; no full-SVG byte identity is claimed.
